question: Given a binary change question, which premises imply its pair and singleton calibrations, which acts and local instruments realize both prior games, and what physical words and records follow?
primary_observable: Exact calibrated and rival signs, all literal and alternative physical game tables, legal post-answer support, ordinary refusals and paired fresh source-stage measurements.
forbidden_inputs: No results enter rule, source, instrument or placement selection. Preserve failed settings, impossible branches and missed stages.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Occupied full pair, occupied singleton and one isolated three-place knot of either law.
first_executable_signal: Every nonempty support on up to three bits and every nonidentity flip. Compare memberwise flips, conditional and signed effects and ordered initial-certain products.
resource_budget: One numerical thread, 4 GiB, 180 knots, 600 marks, 48 births, ordinary treewidth precheck at ten three-valued indices, first reached stage only. No long check anticipated.
stop_rule: Both calibrations derived or missing premise named, biconditional proved or refuted in both directions, continuation, physical refusals and both-law finite stress tested.
decision_or_followup_rule: Leave state-only versus question restriction open. Retain every comparison and contradiction, mark instruments and forks as choices. Independent referee pending.
